commitResults.messageTitle: Add undo feature for data-modifying commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement a single-command undo system that allows users to reverse the
most recent data-modifying command (add, update, delete).

Changes:
- Add isUndoable() method to Command base class to identify
  data-modifying vs read-only commands
- Implement undo() method in AddCommand, UpdateCommand, and all
- DeleteCommand variants (single, multiple, range)
- Add UndoCommand and UndoCommandParser to handle undo execution
- Update LogicManager to track the last undoable command and clear the
  stored command when non-data-modifying commands execute (list, find,
	    help, exit, clear)

Behavior:
- Only consecutive data-modifying commands can be undone
- Each new data-modifying command overwrites the previous one
- Read-only commands (list, find, etc.) clear the undo memory
- Undo itself is never stored as an undoable command
- Error message displayed if no command can be undone or if a read-only
  command was executed after the last data-modifying command

  Storage: Uses a single variable (lastUndoableCommand) instead of a stack to maintain only the most recent undoable command, ensuring consistent and predictable behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add comprehensive test coverage for undo feature
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement thorough unit and integration tests to achieve 100% coverage
for undo functionality across all undoable commands.

Coverage improvements:
- UndoCommand.java: 0% → 100% (9 lines of code)
- UndoCommandParser.java: 0% → 100% (6 lines of code)
- AddCommand.java: 42.85% → improved (added isUndoable, undo, and
  execute tests)
  - UpdateCommand.java: 40.00% → improved (added isUndoable and undo
    tests)
    - SingleDeleteCommand.java: 37.50% → improved (added isUndoable and
      undo tests)
      - MultipleDeleteCommand.java: 33.33% → improved (added isUndoable
	and undo tests)
	- RangeDeleteCommand.java: 33.33% → improved (added isUndoable
	  and undo tests)

	  Tests added:
	  - UndoCommandTest: 5 comprehensive tests covering success and
	    failure cases
	    - UndoCommandParserTest: 3 tests for parser behavior
	    - AddCommandTest: enhanced with isUndoable() and undo()
	      tests
	      - SingleDeleteCommandTest: enhanced with isUndoable() and
		undo() tests
		- MultipleDeleteCommandTest: enhanced with isUndoable()
		  and undo() tests
		  - RangeDeleteCommandTest: enhanced with isUndoable()
		    and undo() tests
		    - UpdateCommandTest: enhanced with isUndoable() and
		      undo() tests
		      - AddressBookParserTest: enhanced with undo
			command routing test

			All tests pass successfully and comply with
			project checkstyle standards.
